meta.building: Helsinki Cathedral (Helsingin tuomiokirkko), golden hour, view from the foot of the grand stairs on Senate Square
meta.units: metres; z=0 at podium top; origin = main dome axis; +X east, +Y north; south facade (grand stairs) faces -Y
notes: Numbers follow the photo fit (spec_photo.md, rms 5.9 px) anchored at 62.0 m podium->cross top, then refined with massing_check.py (27 photo landmarks, rms 10.5 px). spec_arch.md was used only for details the photo cannot show.

Plan: Greek cross with a RECTANGULAR core 33 x 39 m (X +-16.5, Y +-19.5) rising to the attic; arms 22 m wide (+-11). The exposed core corners (|x| in [11,16.5], |y| in [11,19.5]) are the 'corner blocks'; they carry the 4 towers whose pedestals are flush with the core faces.

The core attic (16.5->25.2) is a PLUS shape: the four corner squares |x| in [10.1,16.5] x |y| in [13.1,19.5] belong to the towers (domes module); the attic's south/north faces run between the tower pedestals at |y|=19.5, its east/west faces at |x|=16.5.

South/north porticos: column line |Y|=36.5, arm end wall |Y|=33.5. East/west porticos: column line |X|=29.5, wall |X|=26.5 (photo: the E portico's southernmost column and both E statues are inside the frame).

Camera is 22 m WEST of the axis, 114 m south, 1.5 m above the square: west faces are seen on both front towers and the drum. Sun from the west (azimuth 264, elevation 6.5; photo range 258-272): west faces gold, south faces only grazed (0.1 of direct sun: pale gold on plain bands, grey-blue where a return or cornice shadows them, e.g. the tympanum). Exposure -3.6 keeps the sky as bright as in the photo; the look module may tune sun kwargs within +-5 deg / +-0.4 EV.
In the photo the square, the stairs and the portico east of X~+2 (columns 4-6, east part of the back wall) lie in the shadow of buildings west of the square. Not required to reproduce.

The drum is wider than the dome (cornice R 8.35 vs dome R 7.15); its wall is R 7.1 and the engaged columns reach R 7.6 (the silhouette in the photo); it sits on a cylindrical pedestal hidden behind the attic balustrade from the camera.

Fixer r3: tower pediments rise 0.95 m over half_w 3.0 (17.6 deg, like the 19.3 deg main pediment), upper block 26.95-29.6, plain (no string course). Sun is an explicit warm Sun lamp (mod_look.setup_look: 23 W/m2, colour (1,0.55,0.12), sky disc off) so the lit whites go gold.

camera.notes: sensor_fit AUTO: 36 mm on the long (vertical) side -> VFOV 44.5 deg, HFOV 34.1 deg; yaw 11.9 deg east of north, pitch 22.6 deg up; horizon just below the bottom edge; cross top ~34 % from the top; eye 1.54 m above square_ground_z. Look module: camera kept as fitted; render/view settings (Standard + look None, sun_intensity 0.5, exposure -2.45) live in mod_look.LOOK.

plinth.side_faces: plain granite blocks; the south face is replaced by the grand stairs for |x| <= 28.8, granite wall only outside the stairs

podium.notes: Flat terrace z=0 carrying the whole cathedral; the stairs top edge IS the podium south edge y=-37.5, which is 1.0 m in front of the S column AXES and 0.1 m in front of the column plinth faces (plinth 1.8 sq). Body builds the podium slab + visible granite walls; statues_site builds the stairs and the square ground.
podium.half_d_note: half_d 44 is the NORTH extent only; use y_range (south edge = stairs top = -37.5), never +-half_d

side_walls.top_profile: follows the stair slope from z=0.45 at y=-37.5 to z=-6.6 at the foot, granite

stairs.notes: One continuous flight, no landing, fills the frame bottom (~30 risers visible). 44 x 0.16 = 7.04 m drop; 44 x 0.37 = 16.28 m run.

core.wall_articulation: same as arms: pilasters 1.0 w / 0.2 proud, lower window 2.2x3.6 (z 1.0-4.6), upper window 2.2x2.0 (z 6.6-8.6), pilaster capitals 9.7-11.5, relief panel 2.4x1.1 at z 9.9-11.0 between them; the exposed core faces are the corner-block faces (see corner_blocks); a 1.3 m wide corner pilaster at each convex corner

attic.footprint: plus: X +-16.5 for |y|<=13.1 and Y +-19.5 for |x|<=10.1; the 4 rectangles |x| in [10.1,16.5] x |y| in [13.1,19.5] are the towers' (not built by body above z 16.5)
attic.roof: flat dark copper at z 25.2 inside the balustrade; the drum pedestal rises from it

balustrade.pedestals_at: each end of each face (next to the towers)

side_windows.shape: round-headed, louvred, in a shallow arched panel

core.notes: cornice_top_z 14.2 and the entablature (11.5-14.2) run continuously around core corners, arms and porticos. Core footprint under the arms/towers is solid: body may build it as one box 0->16.5 plus the plus-shaped attic.

parapet.note: plain band (the photo shows it lit gold on all arms)

roof.type: gable along the arm axis; it dies into the core attic wall
roof.note: ridge from the arm end wall to the core face, 0.1 below the pediment apex (18.4); the dark roof shows above the raking cornices as in the photo

common.flank_bays: one bay per ~4.0 m between pilasters along each flank; the bay next to the portico carries the anta pilaster (1.3 w)

arms.notes: Arm end walls at |Y|=33.5 (S/N) and |X|=26.5 (E/W); the porticos stand 3.0 m in front of them. The portico back wall (door, relief panels) IS the arm end wall and belongs to body.

corner_blocks.roof: flat at z 16.5 (dark copper) - mostly covered by the tower pedestal (6.4 m square centred at (+-13.3, +-16.3))
corner_blocks.facade: exposed faces: south/north face at |y|=19.5 for |x| in [11,16.5] (5.5 m: one pilaster bay with a relief panel, a sunk panel and a small window, corner pilaster 1.3 w at the convex corner) and east/west face at |x|=16.5 for |y| in [11,19.5] (8.5 m: two bays); same entablature + parapet as the arms
corner_blocks.notes: These are simply the exposed corners of the 33 x 39 core below the attic. towers.z_base == corner_blocks.top_z == 16.5.

portico.order: Corinthian (two tiers of acanthus leaves + volutes; a lathe bell + box abacus is acceptable)

stylobate.note: none - the columns' plinths stand directly on the podium top z=0 (photo: plinth bottom at z 0.06). Body owns the floor surface.

steps.note: none built by portico: the south grand stairs belong to statues_site; N/E/W porticos have no stairs in this model (podium is a flat terrace)

entablature.returns: short returns from the column line back to the arm end wall (3.0 m) on both flanks at |offset| = 12.0; the arm/core entablature continues from there (body)
entablature.ratio_note: entablature 2.7 m = 23.5 % of the 11.5 m column (photo: abacus top y~1468 -> z 11.5-11.6)

pediment.depth: tympanum wall 0.6 thick in the column-line plane; the gable roof behind (ridge 18.3) belongs to body
pediment.raking_cornice_ends: the raking cornices run from the apex down to |offset| raking_cornice_x_end = 10.75 (beyond the corner pedestals at 9.6); the horizontal cornice continues to +-12.0
pediment.photo_note: photo: cornice apex y~1272 vs corner tips y~1386/1397 -> height/width = 0.88 x the former 4.6 m => 4.2 m (pitch 4.2/24 = 1:5.7)

anta.note: pilaster on each flank at the arm end-wall corner, carrying the entablature return; the flank between the end column and the anta is OPEN (no pier)

apex.set_on: column line (centre of the entablature depth)

corners.set_on: top of the horizontal cornice / inside the tympanum, directly above the end columns (photo), centred 0.9 m behind the column line so the raking cornice hides its lower part; top 15.7 shows ~0.3 m above the raking cornice

acroteria_pedestals.notes: statue z == pedestal z_top: apex 18.8, corners 15.7. Pedestal plan position = (offset along facade, column_line + setback toward the wall) rotated per instance. The apex pedestal is embedded in the pediment (apex 18.4) and shows 0.4 m above it. The raking cornice runs independently to pediment.raking_cornice_x_end (10.75).

pedestal.note: plain cylinder; hidden behind the attic balustrade from the camera

columns.note: bays centred on N/S/E/W (clock in the S bay); columns at azimuth 15+30k deg (clockwise from +Y); shaft 34.0-40.8, capital 40.8-42.2; outer face r 7.6 (0.5 m proud of the 7.1 wall), 0.15 inside the entablature face

entablature.note: architrave + frieze (1.6 m) between the capitals and the dentil cornice

clock.note: replaces the small window in the south bay

drum.notes: Everything in 'drum' from z 25.2 up belongs to domes. Column height 8.2 (shaft 6.8 + capital 1.4); entablature+cornice 3.6 m above it as the photo shows (heavy crown).
drum.radius_note: radius = the shaft WALL (7.1). The engaged columns reach r 7.6, which is the silhouette the photo shows (Ø15.2); entablature 7.75, cornice 7.75->8.35, attic ring 7.3.

balustrade.on: outer edge of the pedestal top, around the shaft

towers.notes: Tower pedestal 6.4 m square sits on the corner block (z 16.5) with its outer faces flush with the core faces (|x|=16.5, |y|=19.5); its inner faces at |x|=10.1 / |y|=13.1 meet the attic. The lit WEST faces of both front towers are visible from the camera.

white_paint.use: columns, pilasters, capitals, entablatures, cornices, pediments, drum, towers, balustrades, window frames

wall.use: plain wall fields between pilasters (arms, core, corner blocks, portico back wall, attic), parapet bands

roof_dark.use: arm roofs, corner-block roofs, attic roof, drum pedestal top

gold.use: orbs, crosses, tower stars, clock hands

granite.use: grand stairs, stair side walls, podium walls

materials.notes: rgb = LINEAR RGB (Principled Base Color). Converted from sRGB: white (236,231,221), wall (214,207,194), patina: fixer r3 olive base (0.055,0.072,0.040) linear, roughness 0.7, specular 0.15 (r2 (0.035,0.055,0.035)/0.35 was too dark on the sun-lit limb and mirrored the sky at the grazing limbs) with a warm specular tint in mod_look (the teal (0.04,0.07,0.055) rendered the dome's W half grey-teal instead of the photo's golden-olive), gold (255,205,90), granite (118,114,110) -> darkened to (0.09,0.084,0.070) linear by fixer r2 (stairs rendered 0.8 EV too bright/blue), zinc (225,222,212).

ownership.body: podium slab + visible granite podium walls (not the stairs), core 0-16.5 incl. corner blocks, core attic (plus-shape 16.5-25.2) with cornice + balustrade + windows + flat roof, arms with walls/pilasters/windows/relief panels, the continuous entablature around arms + core (NOT the portico's part between |offset|<=12 in front of the end walls), parapet bands, arm gable roofs, portico back walls incl. doors and responding pilasters
ownership.portico: for each of the 4 porticos: column plinths/bases/shafts/capitals, the entablature from the column line back to the arm end wall incl. its two 3 m returns, pediment (raking cornices + tympanum), antae, 3 acroteria pedestals; no stylobate/steps
ownership.domes: drum from z 25.2 (pedestal, base ring, foot, shaft, 12 columns, windows, clock, entablature, cornice, attic ring), main dome + ribs + lantern + orb + cross; the 4 towers from z_base 16.5 (pedestal, balustrade, shaft, arch windows, entablature, pediments, upper block, cornice, star dome, orb, cross)
ownership.statues_site: 12 apostle statues (on the portico pedestals, z = pedestal z_top), the grand stairs + side walls from y=-37.5 down to the square, Senate Square ground plane at z=-7.04 (large, >= 400 m)
ownership.look: materials (MATERIAL_SPECS overrides from spec.materials), sky/sun (setup_sun_sky(**spec.sun)), camera (setup_camera from spec.camera), render settings

statues_notes: pos = centre of the figure's feet = pedestal z_top (corner figures 0.9 m behind the column line, on the set-back corner pedestals). facing_deg/yaw_deg = compass direction the figure FACES: 0 = +Y north, 90 = +X east, 180 = -Y south (toward the camera), 270 = -X west. For a figure modelled facing +Y use rotation_euler.z = radians(-yaw_deg). Statue height 3.1 m (zinc), standing, draped, one arm raised; pedestals belong to portico. Visible in the photo: S apex + both S corners, E apex + E south corner, W south corner (frame edge).
